cases.title: Favorite-document locator is not the exemplar
cases.input: User points to a READ FIRST/index document whose links lead to a longer favorite meeting-notes exemplar and a source mirror.
expected: trace locator to actual visual exemplar
distinguish visual exemplar from provenance source and convenience mirror
do not style from the index summary alone

cases.title: Sign-off keeps sign-off structure
cases.input: Create a delivery sign-off with scope, equipment checklist, acceptance, signature and date using the same visual family as meeting notes.

cases.title: SOP uses executable procedure structure
cases.input: Create an SOP from operational evidence.

cases.title: Ledger spreadsheet preserves semantics
cases.input: Restyle an existing Excel ledger without changing its record schema or source authority.
expected: do not treat Google Sheets as required acceptance unless explicitly targeted

cases.title: Ticket tracker is functional before decorative
cases.input: Create or repair a ticket tracker with a professional aesthetic.

cases.title: Reference fidelity precedes H&H palette
cases.input: Use a favorite S-class document aesthetic for an H&H artifact and later apply H&H colors.
expected: brand overlay preserves non-color and pagination fingerprints

cases.title: Verified Word appearance outranks theme-inverted OOXML
cases.input: Raw DOCX/headless rendering appears dark while the operator-verified Microsoft Word view is light.
expected: headless renderer limited to layout QA
no giant dark narrative panels copied from theme-aware internals

cases.title: First prototype cannot self-promote
cases.input: Prototype 1 renders and API operations succeed, but visual comparison exposes spacing/hierarchy defects.
expected: at least two deliberate passes when visual uncertainty is material

cases.title: Reusable correction is backported
cases.input: A manual formatting correction should apply to several sibling artifacts in a repository-backed workflow.
expected: repair or create canonical generator/template/spec/profile and tests before batch propagation

cases.title: Artifact link leads the handoff
cases.input: A real Drive/document artifact has been created and validated.
expected: canonical artifact link/path is first substantive delivery item
process explanation follows as receipt rather than burying the artifact

cases.title: OTHER remains valid
cases.input: The artifact is a new operational form that does not honestly fit existing named archetypes.
expected: derive and state minimal repeatable schema from purpose

cases.title: Synchronization remains separately owned
cases.input: The finished artifact must be published to an established Drive workspace.
expected: professional artifact prompt owns artifact design/acceptance
route repository/provider synchronization to its canonical sync owner
do not invent a second sync mechanism
